paragraphs: Extraordinary family dental care for the Rocky Mount community in the Oakwood area.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Welcome to our Rocky Mount, Oakwood office! Our office stands out with its modern atmosphere and advanced technology, making your dental experience stress-free. Our skillful and attentive team strongly believes that dental care and treatment start with patient comfort. Therefore, we designed our office and amenities with your health and well-being in mind. Our patients feel supported and at ease, leaving motivated and confident to care for their oral health.

Our Rocky Mount, Oakwood location is conveniently situated in a suburban community, just off the US 64/US-64 BUS intersection. It offers small-town charm with easy access to The Imperial Center for the Arts & Science, North Carolina Wesleyan University, and Golden East Crossing Mall. We provide care for the Rocky Mount community and patients traveling from the nearby neighborhoods such as Bethel, Princeville, Tarboro, and more. Our connection with clients goes beyond the dental chair. You are now part of the Riccobene family, where we are committed to providing the comfort and confidence you need for a healthy, painless smile!
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Rocky Mount office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.
We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!
Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include teeth whitening.
Yes. We are always happy to welcome new clients who are motivated to take care of their oral health! Please give us a call or schedule an appointment online. We can't wait to see you!
To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!
Take the first step towards optimal oral health. Contact our Rocky Mount office to schedule your appointment or ask any questions about our dental services.

schemaMarkup.reviewBody: Today was the first visit for my parents, and the service of the entire staff was absolutely amazing. Everyone was extremely helpful and patient with my parents, making for a pleasant experience for them both. I’m glad that we chose this practice for their dental health needs.

Today was my daughter's first time coming to the dentist, and she was extremely nervous. The staff was very nice and polite. They kept us informed during the visit. They work great with kids. My daughter was so happy with her appointment. This is by far one of the best experiences I have had in a while!

I had been awake all night the night before with a toothache, and I called in this morning to see if I could get an appointment, and they took me in. The doctor looked at it and determined it needed to be extracted. She was pleasant and had it out before I knew it. Everyone was so nice.

I called on a Tuesday to schedule an appointment to be seen as a new patient. However, they didn’t have anything available for six weeks out. But the receptionist called me back within an hour and said they had an available appointment for Thursday, which was great. Today, I would say the visit went well, and no judgment from the staff; everyone was very friendly and respectful…I can’t wait to get my treatment plan started. The hygienist and the assistant were very professional and never passed judgment.

Hailing from Lincolnton, Georgia, Dr. Woodard's interest in dentistry was sparked during his middle school years and solidified through a high school mission trip to Nicaragua. He earned his dental degree from the Dental College of Georgia and began his career at Christ Community Health Services in Augusta, focusing on serving underserved populations.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What dental services are offered at Rocky Mount - Oakwood, NC?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

Do you offer teeth whitening services at Rocky Mount - Oakwood, NC?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include teeth whitening.

Are you accepting new patients at your Rocky Mount - Oakwood dental office?

Yes. We are always happy to welcome new clients who are motivated to take care of their oral health! Please give us a call or schedule an appointment online. We can't wait to see you!

How do I schedule an appointment with the Rocky Mount - Oakwood dentist?

To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!
